name: hcportal_setHasherNotesSuppression
description: Platform Admin override on shared run notes (E3.F4.S5): sets or clears bit 0x2000 of HC.Hasher.Preferences, which hides every note the hasher shares in every kennel. Requires HC.PlatformAdmin.CanEditKennel. Private notes are unaffected. No portal UI yet — callable from the portal shim.

parameters.name: hasherId
parameters.description: The hasher (HC.Hasher.id, not deleted). Required — no SQL default.

parameters.name: suppressed
parameters.description: 1 hide, 0 allow (bit 0x2000 = 8192 of HC.Hasher.Preferences). Required — no SQL default; anything but 0/1 is refused.
parameters.typeMismatch: SMALLINT flag mapped onto one bit of the INT-bitfield Hasher.Preferences; the SP sets/clears only bit 0x2000 in place, leaving the other bits untouched.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Always one row. Success = 0 on auth failure, missing CanEditKennel, NULL hasherId or suppressed not 0/1, 'Hasher not found' (after ROLLBACK), or from the CATCH block (ROLLBACK, HC.ErrorLog row, ERROR_MESSAGE()).

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.Hasher SET Preferences |= 0x2000 or &= ~0x2000, updatedAt — fires the hasher updatedAt trigger, so the change syncs
On a runtime error: INSERT HC.ErrorLog after the ROLLBACK

codeSmells.detail: These parameters have no SQL default, so a call that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the procedure runs (unlogged empty 500): @suppressed. On 2026-10-13 every parameter whose body already handled NULL (and every sync watermark) was given a default; these remain because they are the auth pair or the body never checks them for NULL.
